laws.rule: Under the City of Zagreb communal order decision (Odluka o komunalnom redu), bathing in fountains and water jets is banned (Article 58). On public-use surfaces it is banned to leave campervans, trailers, boats or unregistered vehicles (Article 88), and on public green areas it is banned to stop or drive motor vehicles, damage plants, tie bikes to trees or street furniture, or put up tourist or catering stalls without permission (Article 95). Communal wardens enforce it and can hand out a mandatory misdemeanour notice. The unofficial consolidated text read states fines in kuna, so it predates the euro changeover; current amounts were not found.
laws.penalty_signal: fines set in the decision; amount for these articles not confirmed in euros
